mentions.name: MyLLM
mentions.description: MyLLM is a private AI assistant for iPhone that runs language models on-device via llama.cpp with Metal, or against the user's own server, so nothing leaves the phone. Its MyLLMos feature has the assistant build HTML/Python apps on the fly, which can be kept in a gallery and re-run, turning it into a home screen for AI-generated apps. It also includes a free, open, HTML5-based app marketplace whose apps can be edited in-app or generated with external tools like Fable and stored and run on the iPhone.
